description: This file defines R functions and classes for creating and handling Spark DataFrame schemas, specifically focusing on Spark SQL's StructType and StructField objects. It includes methods for constructing schema objects from various inputs, printing schema details, and validating data types.

classes.name: structType
classes.description: Represents a Spark DataFrame schema, supporting creation from various input types and interfacing with JVM objects.

classes.name: structField
classes.description: Represents a single field in a Spark DataFrame schema, including name, data type, and nullability.

methods.name: structType
methods.description: Creates a structType object from structField objects, a DDL string, or a JVM object.

methods.name: structType.jobj
methods.description: Constructs a structType from a JVM object, providing access to its fields.

methods.name: structType.structField
methods.description: Creates a structType from multiple structField objects.

methods.name: structType.character
methods.description: Creates a structType from a DDL-formatted string.

methods.name: print.structType
methods.description: Prints the details of a StructType object.

methods.name: structField
methods.description: Creates a structField object from a name and data type.

methods.name: structField.jobj
methods.description: Constructs a structField from a JVM object, providing access to its properties.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Validates if a data type string is supported for Spark DataFrames.

methods.name: structField.character
methods.description: Creates a structField with specified name, type, and nullability.

methods.name: print.structField
methods.description: Prints the details of a StructField object.
